resources.string: A backup holds all bikes, rides, settings and error logs in one file. Use it to move to a new phone, too.
Backup saved. Keep the file somewhere off the phone, e.g. in your cloud.
The backup could not be saved.
Replaces everything stored on this phone now: bikes, rides and settings. Nothing is merged.
Restoring failed. Restart the app and it will be completed.
Nothing can be restored while a ride is being recorded. Try again after the ride.
This file is not a Robo-Bike backup. Nothing on the phone was changed.
This backup is damaged or incomplete. Nothing on the phone was changed.
This backup comes from a newer app version. Update the app first. Nothing on the phone was changed.
This file is too large for a backup. Nothing on the phone was changed.
Backup from %1$s: %2$s (%3$s), %4$s.\n\nEverything on this phone (%5$s, %6$s and all settings) is deleted and replaced by the backup. This cannot be undone.
The pairing with the display belongs to the old phone. After restoring, the app still knows your display; you confirm it once when connecting the first time. The new phone asks for permissions again.
